title.en: Sharing frontend logic across Web and mobile
title.zh: 大前端心得：Web 与移动端，哪些代码值得共用？

summary.en: Use the membership project to separate domain state from network, storage and device APIs; keep platform verification explicit.
summary.zh: 从会员系统的共享逻辑与平台适配出发，整理业务状态、网络请求、存储和设备能力的拆分办法。

basis.en: Reviewed the public membership revision ef8c6cd: shared composables, Web components and the uni-app adapter. The source shows the design; this review did not perform a new native-device release.
basis.zh: 审阅会员系统公开版本 ef8c6cd 的 shared 组合式函数、Web 组件与 uni-app 适配层。本次核对代码结构，未重新执行原生应用发布或真机验收。

paragraphs.en: The project keeps useGallery, useForum, useChat and useWeather under shared/. Web and mobile components render their own interfaces around that state. useWeather accepts an API function; the component supplies location acquisition. This makes search and request-order behavior testable without a browser permission prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 项目将 useGallery、useForum、useChat、useWeather 放在 shared/，Web 与移动端组件分别渲染界面。useWeather 接收 API 函数，定位能力由组件传入，因此可以在不弹出浏览器定位授权框的情况下测试搜索和请求顺序。

paragraphs.en: A useful extraction criterion is whether the rule has the same meaning on both platforms. An order status usually does. Choosing a file, requesting a location and downloading a temporary file have different platform behavior and belong behind adapters.
paragraphs.zh: 判断是否值得抽取，可以先看规则在两端是否具有同一个含义。订单状态通常可以共用；选择文件、获取位置和下载临时文件涉及平台差异，适合放进适配层。

title.en: Give platform capabilities a narrow interface
title.zh: 把平台能力收成小接口

paragraphs.en: The mobile adapter uses uni.request, uni.uploadFile and uni storage. Its request function captures the token before sending; a late 401 clears the session only if that token still matches the current one. Keeping this decision at the request boundary avoids each screen inventing its own expiry behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 移动端适配使用 uni.request、uni.uploadFile 与 uni 存储。请求前保存令牌，迟到的 401 仅在请求令牌仍等于当前令牌时清除会话。把这个判断放在请求入口，可以减少各页面对登录失效的不同处理。

paragraphs.en: The following interface is a proposed extraction, not a claim that the current project already implements this exact type. A capability should describe its failure behavior as well as its return value.
paragraphs.zh: 下面是建议的抽象形式，不是当前项目已经实现的同名类型。接口除返回值外，还需约定用户取消、授权拒绝和网络失败如何表示。

title.en: Shared Vue logic still depends on Vue
title.zh: 共享 Vue 逻辑仍然依赖 Vue

paragraphs.en: These composables import ref, watch and lifecycle hooks. They can be shared across the current Vue clients, but a React client cannot simply import them as framework-independent domain code. Pure validation and transition functions are better candidates for reuse across frameworks.
paragraphs.zh: 这些组合式函数依赖 ref、watch 和生命周期钩子，适合在当前 Vue 客户端之间复用。若增加 React 客户端，不能直接把它们当作无框架依赖的业务代码。纯校验、状态迁移函数更适合跨框架使用。

paragraphs.en: The existing domain.ts uses Row = Record<string, any>. It makes early iteration convenient, but leaves response assumptions unchecked. A next step is to introduce explicit DTOs at API boundaries, then validate external data at runtime. A TypeScript annotation alone cannot validate JSON returned by a server.
paragraphs.zh: 现有 domain.ts 使用 Row = Record<string, any>，迭代方便，但接口字段约定较弱。后续可以先为 API 边界补明确的 DTO，再对外部数据做运行时校验。只写 TypeScript 类型，不能保证服务端返回的 JSON 符合约定。

title.en: What was checked and what remains

paragraphs.en: On 29 October, the existing request-scope script passed five deferred-response scenarios and the weather script passed twelve scenarios. Their Vue harness stubs mount and unmount registration; these checks do not establish complete lifecycle integration or identical behavior on H5, WeChat and native clients.
paragraphs.zh: 10 月 29 日复跑了既有脚本：请求作用域 5 个延迟响应场景、天气 12 个场景均通过。测试使用 Vue 逻辑夹具并替代部分挂载／卸载注册，不能据此认定 H5、小程序与原生端行为完全一致。

paragraphs.en: For the next platform change, I would record file-picker cancellation, background/resume behavior, location refusal and session expiry separately on each target. This makes the remaining work visible before calling a build ready for release.
paragraphs.zh: 下次增加平台能力时，值得按目标端分别记录文件选择取消、后台恢复、定位拒绝和会话失效。这样在判断能否发布之前，就能看见还缺哪些证据。
